claim_scope: Test whether exact intersection of the target-conditioned left-pair midpoint domain and the right-pair midpoint domain reduces unsupported compact-S3 search on Q1481's exact full N53/N83 window-orbit bases. This is a PDP stage diagnostic, not a complete IC solver or N131 2^x.
parent_inputs: Q1482 byte-identical six-cell CNFs, variable maps, target files, planted fixtures, and ordinary public points

point_decomposition.chain: balanced three-S3 chain, same Q1482 CNF
point_decomposition.solver_family: CaDiCaL plus external exact F2^n root and finite-domain theory
point_decomposition.theory_delta: Before deciding a complete second midpoint, bound each partial leaf pair by at most 4096 weight-d superset completions. Build the target-conditioned left second-midpoint domain as in Q1480, build the right second-midpoint domain from exact S3 roots of all right pair completions, and intersect the sorted domains under assigned midpoint bits. An empty intersection emits a clause guarded by every assigned target selector, leaf bit and second-midpoint bit; common intersection bits imply midpoint literals. Retain Q1480's final conditioned join when the midpoint is fixed.
point_decomposition.soundness_basis: The weight-d completion sets contain every Q1482 cyclic-window-valid completion. Both domains are exact over that superset; an empty intersection therefore excludes no valid window relation.
point_decomposition.decision_order: target selector; left leaves until at most 4096 pair completions; right leaves until at most 4096 pair completions; second midpoint; remaining leaves and first midpoint

controls: Exhaustive small-field validation must show no false rejection of an x-only S3 chain under partial pair and midpoint assignments.
Both pinned N53/N83 public-point controls must replay as independently verified four-distinct-column relations.
Both unpinned planted targets have known solutions but do not estimate ordinary yield.
success_gates: Report every cell, including timeouts and failures, with exact SAT and field-operation counts, exclusive charged stage wall intervals, peak RSS, and source/runtime receipts.
Only an independently verified unpinned ordinary N83 relation supplies successful N83 stage cost; a frozen ordinary panel is still required for natural yield and rank.
Keep complete N131 2^x null and the challenge gate closed until all IC phases are charged in one unit.
